listings.title: Ameritron AL-811H (needs work)
listings.work_flag: Not putting out full rated power — around 400W PEP on a brief test; tubes may be tired; a previous owner replaced a power-supply capacitor and the seller says the work was done very sloppily. Plus shipping (amount not stated; seller warns it will be high).

listings.title: Collins KWM-2A transceiver
listings.work_flag: needs work — band-switch steel cable off its pulleys; receiver works on 80 meters; transmitter untested; offered as is. Seller replaced some electrolytic capacitors; plug-in relay modification fitted

listings.title: Kenwood TS-2000
listings.work_flag: PLL unlock — the synthesizer loses lock and the transmitter shuts down (seller's words: 'unlocked PLL'). No mic included; manual and DC cord are.

listings.title: Yaesu FC-757AT auto tuner (as-is)
listings.work_flag: Unit powers on but does not function properly. Sold AS-IS for repair, restoration, or parts. No guarantee of tuning operation. Complete front panel with all buttons and controls intact; normal cosmetic wear consistent with age. Plus shipping (amount not stated).

listings.title: Icom IC-7200 (needs work)
listings.work_flag: Fire/lightning damage — the radio was involved in a fire resulting from a lightning strike. 'It powers on but doesn't do much else.' The seller sees no visible physical damage inside. Includes the long power cord only. Sold as-is for parts or repair. $250 shipped to CONUS.

listings.title: MFJ-962D (for parts)
listings.work_flag: 'FOR PARTS!! This tuner arced badly out of the blue the other day' — the damage shows in the seller's photos. 'Selling AS-IS for parts or if someone can repair it.' $40 shipped CONUS.
